name: Collector's Cage
obligation: Hideaway privately selects one of five and randomizes the remainder; retain inspection rights across control changes and source-incarnation links. Evaluate three distinct powers after the counter; play now, with land limits and mandatory extra costs.

name: Grand Abolisher
obligation: During its controller's turn prohibit opponents casting and activating battlefield artifacts/creatures/enchantments, including their mana abilities; retain land-only activations and abilities of cards in other zones.

name: Oltec Matterweaver
obligation: Choose mode at trigger placement; copy only a targeted artifact token you control, preserving copy exceptions, or create the exact colorless 1/1 artifact Gnome.

name: Rest in Peace
obligation: Exile both graveyards on entry; replace every card/token graveyard arrival from every zone, including simultaneous source departure, without generating false dies events.

name: Esoteric Duplicator
obligation: Each sacrificed artifact including itself supplies its own copiable snapshot; optional payment creates a next-end-step copy watcher that survives source and original-token disappearance.

name: Simulacrum Synthesizer
obligation: Scry two on entry; another artifact entering with mana value at least three creates a 0/0 Construct whose static +1/+1 counts all controlled artifacts, including itself, continuously.

name: Worldwalker Helm
obligation: Replace each artifact-token creation event with that event plus one Map, carrying creation instructions and subsequent references across every resulting token; copy activation targets an artifact token.

name: Greed's Gambit
obligation: Compose entry draw/life/three flying 2/1 black Bats and end-step upkeep; leaves trigger discards three, loses six, then chooses and sacrifices three creatures as one instruction, as many as possible.

name: Harvester of Misery
obligation: Entry gives other creatures -2/-2 until cleanup; separate hand ability discards this card as a cost before the targeted -2/-2 effect resolves.

name: Hostile Investigator
obligation: ETB targets an opponent to discard; any player's single or simultaneous discard event investigates once, with limit spent on triggering rather than optional acceptance.

name: Generous Plunderer
obligation: Optional upkeep Treasure creation creates a separate targeted reflexive trigger giving the opponent a tapped Treasure; attack damage counts defending player artifacts at resolution.

name: Legion Extruder
obligation: ETB damage targets any target; activation pays mana/tap and sacrifices a different artifact before creating the exact colorless 3/3 artifact Golem.

name: Memory Vessel
obligation: Sorcery-speed activation exiles source as a cost; each player gets only their seven exiled cards, including lands, and cannot play hand cards until the activator's next turn begins.

name: Molten Duplication
obligation: Copy a controlled artifact or creature with artifact added to copiable types; haste is a separate temporary grant and next-end-step sacrifice follows the created objects, never a blinked incarnation.

name: Territory Forge
obligation: Only cast entry exiles target artifact/land; statically inherit its activated abilities, including mana abilities, never triggered/static abilities, with self-references rebound and exact exile link retained.

name: Ancient Cornucopia
obligation: Gain life by spell colors rather than mana symbols or payment; declining leaves the once-per-turn option unused, and countered spells retain color context. Tap ability chooses any color. Stop later triggers after acceptance; the current resolution-only option guard alone does not prove that behavior.

name: Bristlebud Farmer
obligation: Entry creates two Foods; attack may sacrifice any Food, then mill three and optionally select a permanent among cards actually available from that mill. Reuse MillAndSelect but verify replacement-aware candidates.

name: Omenpath Journey
obligation: Search up to five lands with distinct layered names, exile and shuffle; each end step randomly moves one still-linked exiled card tapped, preserving source identity and deterministic fork RNG.

name: Sandstorm Salvager
obligation: Create the exact 3/3 Golem; activation counters each currently controlled creature token and gives that affected set trample through cleanup, without affecting later arrivals.

name: Vaultborn Tyrant
obligation: Entry checks current power for this or another controlled creature; death trigger uses nontoken source status and copies departed copiable values with artifact added, so the resulting token cannot repeat the death copy.

name: Loot, the Key to Everything
obligation: Ward costs one; upkeep counts distinct card types across other nonland permanents, not permanents or creature subtypes, then exiles that many cards playable only this turn.

name: Pest Control
obligation: Destroy all nonland permanents of mana value at most one in one event; cycling is a separate hand activation paying two and discarding source before drawing.

name: Lost Jitte
obligation: Charge triggers on equipped creature combat damage to any recipient, not just players; remove a charge as an upfront cost, announce mode and targets, and do not target equipped creature for the counter mode.

name: Lotus Ring
obligation: Equip grants +3/+3, vigilance and tap/sacrifice production of three mana of one chosen color; grant is a mana ability, respects summoning sickness, sacrifices bearer rather than Equipment, and supports real parent payment.

name: Nexus of Becoming
obligation: Own combat draws first, then optionally exiles an artifact/creature from hand; copy that exact card as base 3/3 with Golem/artifact/creature additions retained as copiable values.

name: Sword of Wealth and Power
obligation: Equip grants +2/+2 and protection from instant/sorcery sources; combat-player hit creates Treasure and one this-turn next-cast copy watcher, preserving modes, X, targets and cast provenance while allowing retargeting. Reuse the existing attachment match behind EnchantedCreature after clarifying its Equipment contract.

name: Torpor Orb
obligation: Suppress every ability caused by a creature entering, including noncreature observers of artifact creatures; preserve as-enters replacements and evaluate creature status after entry layers.

name: Transmutation Font
obligation: Tap selects Blood/Clue/Food; sorcery activation requires three artifact tokens with different current names sacrificed atomically as costs, then optional qualified library search to battlefield and shuffle.

name: Fomori Vault
obligation: Keep colorless tap mana separate from paid tap/discard activation; count artifacts at resolution, choose exactly one inspected card when available, then randomize the remainder privately.

name: Tarnation Vista
obligation: Enter tapped and choose a persistent color; second mana ability pays one before tapping and produces one of each color represented by monocolored permanents, not one per permanent or multicolored card.
